title: Define self-only allowlist/{email} rules and gate users/{uid} creation on isAllowlisted()

violation.problem: studio/firestore.modules.rules currently has no /allowlist/{email} match block and permits any signed-in Google user to create and read users/{uid} via `allow read, write: if isOwner(uid);` without checking verified email membership in the allowlist collection.
violation.expectedSolution: Import `hasClaim` from `'membership'`, define `hasVerifiedEmail()` and `isAllowlisted()` using `exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/allowlist/$(request.auth.token['email'].lower()))`, add `match /allowlist/{email}` permitting `get` only on the caller's own verified lowercase email (`allow list, write: if false;`), gate `match /users/{uid}` on `isAllowlisted()`, and resolve `studio/firestore.modules.rules` to `studio/firestore.rules`.

requiredPatterns: allow create, update: if isOwner(uid) && isAllowlisted();
